rules.name: Ability Modifier
rules.beginner_description: Convert an ability score to the modifier added to relevant D20 Tests and other calculations.

rules.name: Proficiency Bonus
rules.beginner_description: A level-one character adds +2 when a rule says the character is proficient.

rules.name: Saving Throw Modifier
rules.beginner_description: Use the relevant ability modifier and add Proficiency Bonus only for proficient saving throws.

rules.name: Skill Modifier
rules.beginner_description: Use the relevant ability modifier and add Proficiency Bonus only when proficient in the skill.

rules.name: Passive Perception
rules.beginner_description: Passive Perception equals 10 plus the complete Wisdom (Perception) check modifier.

rules.name: Initiative Modifier
rules.beginner_description: Initiative normally uses Dexterity; Alert adds Proficiency Bonus because it grants Initiative proficiency.

rules.name: Level-One Hit Points
rules.beginner_description: A level-one Fighter's Hit Point maximum equals 10 plus Constitution modifier.

rules.name: Speed
rules.beginner_description: Human base Speed is 30 feet; armor can reduce it when its Strength requirement is not met.

rules.name: Unarmored Armor Class
rules.beginner_description: Without armor or a Shield, base Armor Class equals 10 plus Dexterity modifier.

equipment.name: Chain Mail State
equipment.beginner_description: Chain Mail provides base Armor Class 16, requires Strength 13 to avoid a Speed penalty, and imposes Disadvantage on Stealth checks.

equipment.name: Greatsword Equipment State
equipment.beginner_description: A Greatsword requires two hands when readied for mechanical use and begins carried until selected as held/readied.

equipment.name: Flail Equipment State
equipment.beginner_description: A Flail is a one-handed weapon and begins carried until selected as held.

equipment.name: Javelin Equipment State
equipment.beginner_description: A Javelin is a one-handed weapon and begins carried until selected as held.

resources.name: Second Wind Uses
resources.beginner_description: A level-one Fighter begins with two uses; a Short Rest restores one and a Long Rest restores all.

resources.name: Heroic Inspiration
resources.beginner_description: A Human starts the day with one Heroic Inspiration and can never hold more than one.

resources.name: Fighter Hit Dice
resources.beginner_description: A level-one Fighter has one d10 Hit Die, which can be spent during a Short Rest and is restored by a Long Rest.
